integrity: All-n proof reconstructed from exact projected facet normals, a Monge permutation-assignment mass bound and complete equality classification. New exact finite checks and independent LP optimizations corroborate but do not prove the infinite family.
scientific_limitations: Square normalized nonsymmetric Monge polytopes with intrinsic Frobenius metric. Full 2026 same-family primary PDF could not be obtained; relevant unread material remains a residual originality risk.
title: An affine \(n-1\)-cube of Euclidean incenters for square Monge polytopes
